rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent compact mass with a clear dominant carved-void gesture, and it is legible in all four views rather than collapsing into a single-view trick. The sloped/truncated top and planar side cuts give it a capacity-bearing landform quality, not just arbitrary stacking. The west-oriented carve appears to answer the required access edge reasonably well, though the public threshold is still modest and somewhat sealed compared with the strongest neighborhood-living precedents. Program-wise, the mass can plausibly support a compact neighborhood/commercial living brief: it is not a tower or hall, and it retains an active ground logic through the carved face. The main weakness is that the section is still somewhat sculptural and a bit boxy at the base, so the void/entry relationship could be more explicit and publicly usable.
